stimulus: A heavy iron ball is lobbed gently over a short wall.
A baseball is fired in a hard, flat throw from the outfield to home plate.
A tennis ball is tossed softly underhand to a child standing a few feet away.
A football is punted with full force high into the sky and far down the field.
A water balloon is lobbed slowly and high over a tall fence into the next yard.
A flat stone is skipped hard and low across a calm pond.
A crumpled ball of paper is flicked lightly into a wastebasket right beside the desk.
A javelin is launched with great force in a high soaring arc down the field.
A tiny pebble is dropped gently into a calm pond.
A marble is thrown hard into a still swimming pool.
A large beach ball is set down softly onto a quiet lake.
A heavy boulder crashes into a deep mountain lake.
A single raindrop falls onto a smooth puddle.
A bullet strikes the surface of a full bathtub.
A wide wooden plank is lowered slowly onto the surface of a pool.
A wide, flat sheet of steel slaps flat onto the surface of a still lake.
A bright light bulb hangs low, one foot to the left of a tall cylinder.
The afternoon sun shines from high up on the right side of a lone tree.
A flashlight lying on the floor shines from the right at a tall vase.
A streetlamp towers high above and to the left of a parked bicycle.
The noon sun blazes almost directly overhead a tall flagpole.
A candle sits on the table just to the right of a wine bottle.
A ceiling lamp hangs high and slightly to the left of a wooden chair.
The setting sun sits low on the horizon far to the left of a lighthouse.
